title: A Horizon for the Compass
author: Isandro Joubert
blurb: Mirabel Sterling, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
